caption: The drawing depicts a scene featuring a cart being pulled by a brown donkey with a yellow harness and red trappings. The cart has two large red wheels with yellow and black details. Seated on the cart is a figure dressed in a blue jacket, red pants, white shoes, and a beige hat with a blue band, holding a white bowl and a spoon. To the right of the donkey, walking on the ground, is another figure in a red shirt, blue pants, and dark shoes, with an upright posture and holding an object in the right hand. The figures have dark skin, with exaggerated facial features. The entire assembly stands on a green base that resembles grass with some small white patches and flowers, and there is a curved, grey pathway with the letters "I AM THE JUDGE" engraved on its surface. The drawing uses mostly muted earth tones, with the primary colors being red, yellow, brown, blue, and green.
title: Toy Bank: Donkey and Cart
